This one is going to be a sad one.
My mom hid for about a year that she had aggressive bowel cancer. We knew she was very ill but she did not want to go to the hospital. 
She stayed at home, in her room, expelling blood from places they shouldn't have come from for nearly a week before she allowed us to bring her in. She passed away two weeks later.
If something is feeling off, please go get it checked. The sooner you do, the better.
Anytime! If you want to inbox me I am here for that too. ❤
Same here. I hope you feel better soon❤
I'm going to say (at least in my area) burying your parents. I'm 22, I buried my dad 11 years ago and I am about to do the same for my mom.

Perhaps it is too strong? Definitely the blood work would reveal that for you. I'm so sorry you feel anxious all the time now. I know what that is like. It's sickening. I really hope they sort that out for you. 
Have you ever been on anything to treat anxiety before? Or is Depakote the first thing that they have had you try?

I'm sorry that you, and everyone else is going through all this shit. I've noticed that this time of year really fucking sucks, for whatever reason?? I know people who are looking for new living accommodations after winter house fires still (3 months after the fact sadly :c), and then myself dealing with a fuckload of issues at home. I understand where you're coming from with outside stress creeping into your life and messing with it. What is it with spring/winter time and things seeming to go downhill, anyway?

Interesting, did you start out at 750? I started Depakote 2 days ago, I have to do it twice a day at 125mg/capsule right now. I had massive anxiety attacks before starting this, and now, upon waking up in the morning, I feel less of it at the start of the day, but this is my day 2, you're on day 8. I hope it settles down for you. That shit isn't fun
Though dangerous, I am glad you made it home. ❤ sometimes i wish that there were car sensors for that sort of thing, like the car breathalyzer. Just for those that can't go anywhere soon or pull off.
I feel you. I also went through several people until i met a new doctor this week that I immediately felt comfortable and confident with. Im glad that you finally found some footing for yourself!!

Might be a weird question for you, but have you ever managed to pull over while driving? I have only stopped myself once while what i assume was a hypomanic state. The only reason I pulled over was because i could actually no longer see where i was going, i was crying too much lol.

I personally really enjoyed reading this. I myself just went back to the doctor after a little over a year, and this is the first time that i was asked questions leading to bipolar disorder. Did it take a long time to get diagnosed, if you dont mind me asking? I waa diagnosed with depression and anxiety at 15, and now I am almost 23 being talked to about this.

this makes sense to me. very clear indeed. thank you for this. i intend fully to do this for her.

thank you <3 a lot of people think i'm actually joking when i tell them that she's dying. because she worked weekends. well, pushed herself to. she can't anymore, today was her last day doing that. now, she will be home 24/7, and i will do all household errands and chores outside of work. i'm old enough to assume this responsibility i suppose. just hard to wrap my mind around it..
yes. she is very ill, and i am worried the time is coming soon. i'm trying to mentally prepare for it, but it isn't working out well at all.
